parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This is one half of a scissor assembly, consisting of a blade and its connected handle, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as one cutting edge and one handle arm of the scissors, working together with the other half to perform cutting actions.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the pivot joint to open and close against the other blade, enabling the cutting motion.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This is the second half of the scissor assembly, also consisting of a blade and handle, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It forms the complementary cutting edge and handle arm, working in conjunction with the first part to shear materials.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots relative to the first blade handle set, creating the scissoring motion used for cutting.
